Why Reading Slowly Works

The students who had struggled with long sentences finally noticed a pattern, and their reading speed improved within a few weeks.

Although the passage looked intimidating at first, it broke down into a handful of familiar structures once they paid attention to the verbs.

A sentence that seems impossible to parse usually contains one main clause and several modifiers hanging off it.

Once you can name the parts, the meaning follows almost automatically, because the grammar itself tells you which words belong together.

Translation alone rarely builds that skill, so the cards show the English structure and the Chinese meaning side by side.
